contact.evidence: Each pose visibly retains at least one supporting foot on the belt. Supporting feet travel backward while the opposite foot swings forward. Fixed rear support and front wheel edges and complete horizontal widths measured identically across all6; moving shoe coordinates are deliberately not treated as fixed anchors.

physics.evidence: Steady walking variation supported by catalogue. Alternating heel contact, loading and swing; one foot remains on the belt, arms counter-swing, hands remain free of rails. Frame6 leads to next near heel contact. Illustrative six-pose cycle, not a calibrated gait simulation.

cueAgreement.evidence: Six cues of at most seven words describe natural stepping, weight transfer, opposite swing, alternate heel contact, counter-swinging arms and an even stride.
